name: Elegant Casting

components.pose: She stands in a wide, sweeping casting stance, front knee bent and back leg extended, torso twisting, one arm swept high with fingers spread as if drawing spirits up from the ground, the other hand curled low in front of her ribs weaving a slow spiral of mist, chin lifted, an imperious gaze locked on the camera. A strong breeze streams her gown, sleeves and hair sideways. No weapon or staff - casting with her bare hands only.
components.effects: Swirling {{MAGIC}} necromantic mist rises from the ground and spirals up her raised arm, faint spectral glyphs drifting upward.

notes: Elegant casting: unique gown that fits her magic, hands-only complex casting stance with wind.
